description: Reads, creates, changes and removes automation rules: deterministic when-if-then rules that run without AI, on every plan and on self-hosted instances. A rule has a trigger (a record created or updated, a field changed to a value, a date reached with an offset in days before or after, a message received, a form submitted, an incoming webhook or a booking cancelled or rescheduled), optional conditions on the triggering record and one or more effects (set a field, create a record such as an Action, notify members, send an outbound webhook). A rule runs once per record and occurrence, as its owner, with the owner's permissions: it cannot do more than the owner could. Changes a rule makes cannot start the same rule again, and a chain stops after two rules. action list returns compact summaries; get returns one rule in full; runs returns one rule's history, newest first, each with its status, the affected record and the outcome of every effect; a run whose record the caller may not read has recordId null, and a date rule's run then also scheduledFor null. action create needs name, trigger and effects; omitting enabled produces a LIVE rule and enabled false creates a draft. Plans limit the number of active rules; the refusal names the limit. action update changes only the keys supplied; trigger, conditions and effects REPLACE their previous value. Only the owner may change or enable a rule. action enable and disable switch a rule on and off; its history is kept; an administrator may also disable. action delete removes the rule and its history permanently and is IRREVERSIBLE. action preview lists which records a date-reached rule would hit on its upcoming sweep (at most 200 are checked), without running anything.

action.description: Rule operation. Keys per action: list = optional typeId, owner, page, pageSize; get, enable, disable and delete = id; runs = id, optional cursor; create = name, trigger, effects, then optional conditions, enabled; update = id plus any of name, trigger, conditions, effects, enabled; preview = id, or trigger with optional conditions (date-reached rules only).

conditions.description: AND-combined checks on the record that triggered the rule: equals, notEquals, in, notIn, empty, notEmpty, before, after (a date or relativeDays from today). create and update; on update REPLACES the conditions, an empty array clears them. Not available for message triggers.

relativeDays.description: For before and after, in place of value: today plus this many days, read when the rule runs.

value.description: Compared value for equals, notEquals, before and after.

values.description: Accepted values for in and notIn.

items.description: Typed CRM value; only the fields for the selected kind are allowed. A decimal carries a currency, null when it has none. For richText writes send documentJson as a ProseMirror document JSON string, not the Markdown returned on read. A file value lists uploaded file ids in order; the server formats an address value from its parts.

cursor.description: runs only. The nextCursor of the previous page. Omit it for the newest runs.

effects.description: What happens, in order: setField on the triggering record, createRecord (for example an Action in the tasks list with a title, a due date offset, an assignee and a link to the triggering record), notify (members get a bell notification and, by their preference, an email) and callWebhook (one of the outbound webhooks). Required on create; on update REPLACES the effects. {{record.name}} and {{rule.name}} work in titles and text. A failed effect stops the later ones.

oneOf.description: Sets fields on the record that triggered the rule.

anyOf.description: Typed CRM value; only the fields for the selected kind are allowed. A decimal carries a currency, null when it has none. For richText writes send documentJson as a ProseMirror document JSON string, not the Markdown returned on read. A file value lists uploaded file ids in order; the server formats an address value from its parts.

candidateToken.description: Address only, in place of value: a candidateToken from an address lookup stores the verified address.

oneOf.description: Creates a record, for example an Action in the tasks list, linked to the triggering record.

due.description: Sets the due date to the day the rule fires plus the offset.

fieldId.description: A date or date and time field of the new record's list.

anyOf.description: Typed CRM value; only the fields for the selected kind are allowed. A decimal carries a currency, null when it has none. For richText writes send documentJson as a ProseMirror document JSON string, not the Markdown returned on read. A file value lists uploaded file ids in order; the server formats an address value from its parts.

candidateToken.description: Address only, in place of value: a candidateToken from an address lookup stores the verified address.

link.description: Links the new record to the record that triggered the rule through this relationship.

typeId.description: The list that receives the new record, usually the tasks list.

oneOf.description: Adds a notification to the bell of the chosen members, with an email when their preference asks for one.
Sends the rule payload to one of the workspace's outbound webhooks.

webhookId.description: An enabled outbound webhook of the workspace; an unknown id is refused.

oneOf.description: Asks an agent to act on the triggering record, through the runtime the workspace chose.

model.description: ownKey only: a model id the workspace's provider keys offer. When omitted, the default model of the workspace's only key is saved with the step; required when the workspace has several keys.

prompt.description: The task for the agent. May use {{record.name}} and {{rule.name}}; the record is handed over as context.

runnerId.description: runner only: a runner of the rule's owner that is not revoked; any live runner of the owner when omitted.

runtime.description: mate runs on the hosted assistant, ownKey on the workspace's provider key, runner on a connected runner.

enabled.description: create and update. Omitting it on create produces a LIVE rule; pass false to save a draft.

id.description: Rule id. Required for get, runs, update, enable, disable and delete; optional for preview.

owner.description: list only. mine returns the rules the caller owns.

pageSize.description: list only. Results per page, any whole number from 1 to 100, served exactly: page 2 of pageSize 50 holds records 51 to 100. When a result was truncated, ask again with about half the size. Default 25.

trigger.description: When the rule fires. Required on create; on update REPLACES the trigger. kind is recordCreated, recordUpdated, fieldChanged, dateReached (a date or date and time field, days before or after, at an hour in a time zone), messageReceived, formSubmitted, webhookReceived or bookingChanged (a booking cancelled or rescheduled; change is any, cancelled or rescheduled). List and field ids are the stable ids of the record model.

oneOf.description: Fires when a record is created in the list.

timezone.description: IANA time zone in which today is read for relativeDays conditions and due dates of created records. UTC when omitted.

typeId.description: Stable id of the list (record type).

oneOf.description: Fires when a record in the list is updated.

fieldIds.description: Fire only when one of these fields changed. Empty means any field.

timezone.description: IANA time zone in which today is read for relativeDays conditions and due dates of created records. UTC when omitted.

typeId.description: Stable id of the list (record type).

oneOf.description: Fires when one field of a record changed, optionally to a given value.

timezone.description: IANA time zone in which today is read for relativeDays conditions and due dates of created records. UTC when omitted.

to.description: Fire only when the field changed to exactly this value.

typeId.description: Stable id of the list (record type).

oneOf.description: Fires once per record when the date of a field, shifted by the offset, is reached.

atHour.description: Hour of the day in the time zone, for date fields.

days.description: Days before or after the date.

direction.description: before fires days earlier than the date, after days later.

fieldId.description: A date or date and time field of the list.

timezone.description: IANA time zone the offset and hour are read in.

typeId.description: Stable id of the list (record type).

oneOf.description: Fires when a message arrives in a connected account the rule owner can access.

timezone.description: IANA time zone in which today is read for relativeDays conditions and due dates of created records. UTC when omitted.

oneOf.description: Fires when a public form submission created a record.

sourceId.description: Restrict the rule to one form.

timezone.description: IANA time zone in which today is read for relativeDays conditions and due dates of created records. UTC when omitted.

typeId.description: Stable id of the list (record type).

oneOf.description: Fires when an incoming webhook created or updated a record.

sourceId.description: Restrict the rule to one incoming webhook endpoint.

timezone.description: IANA time zone in which today is read for relativeDays conditions and due dates of created records. UTC when omitted.

typeId.description: Stable id of the list (record type).

oneOf.description: Fires when the invitee or the host cancelled or rescheduled a booking that created a record.

change.description: cancelled or rescheduled fires only on that change, any on both.

sourceId.description: Restrict the rule to one booking page.

timezone.description: IANA time zone in which today is read for relativeDays conditions and due dates of created records. UTC when omitted.

typeId.description: The list of the record the booking created.
list only. Limits the list to rules about this list (record type).

workspace.description: Slug or id of the workspace to work in. Optional when the account has exactly one usable workspace; required when it has several. An API key always works in its own workspace.

name: manage_rules

outputSchema.description: list returns items, total, page and pageSize; runs returns runs and nextCursor (null on the last page); get, create, update, enable and disable return the rule with its trigger, conditions and effects; delete returns deleted and id; preview returns supported, total, recordIds (at most 50), alreadyFired and truncated (true when more records are in reach than one preview looks at, so total is a lower bound).
